units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Hello, and welcome to the first walk of Saturday.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And I'm Ben. Two stops. One building made of the world, and one sandwich.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: I'm in. And I've got a bet. The sandwich will be on fire with something called giardiniera.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It will be hot, if you ask for hot.
